args.action_description: FRAME FORMAT: identical even canvas, constant physical pivot, fixed whole-body scale and exact source palette. Preserve original character, helmet, armor, body height and rigid weapon dimensions in every frame. Keep the existing LOW TOP-DOWN view and existing direction. North aims up away from viewer, south down, east right, west left. Never switch to front pseudo3D or a different camera. Full body visible with transparent margins. Gosfer cyborg boss raises his existing heavy gun, fires a controlled long burst with rigid fixed-length barrel and small recoil, flashes on muzzle only. Both hands maintain grip, boots stay planted. The gun must point exactly the current facing; north points up, not left. Preserve his skull metal face, dark black-red armor and amber eyes.
